metadata.dataset: Bike trails — FULL STATE, no corridor clip (Paul, Nov 18, 2026)
source_services: OpenStreetMap ways named 'Mesabi Trail' (harvest_mesabi_osm.py: Nominatim + OSM API)
metadata.scope: Statewide. Follows the motorized layers' full-state precedent (Paul, Nov 16, 2026): every DNR bike-allowed state trail in Minnesota plus the Mesabi Trail from OSM.
metadata.miles_method: Whole features measured in UTM 15N (EPSG:26915); no clipping, so DNR field and drawn miles agree except where the service itself splits a trail.
